A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain 26 readable pages, including Appendices A–E. Full text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the scientific content and presentation.

before.justification: v3 reports original Gaussian and KDE simulations, language-model fine-tuning and pretraining experiments, and linear-regression results in Sections 2–4 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments, including the model-collapse comparisons and real/synthetic-data mixture analysis in Figures 1–20.

M1.justification: The replace, accumulate, and accumulate-subsample workflows retain identical fitting, sampling, training, and fine-tuning procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions cover Gaussian modeling, KDE on Blobs/Circles/Moons/Swiss Roll, HelpSteer2 fine-tuning, linear regression, and TinyStories pretraining, with unchanged test scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments, including comparisons among the three training workflows. The newly cited Gillman et al. work appears only in the literature citation list and bibliography.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, Gemma 2 model sizes, fixed-size subsampling, data filtering and mixture construction, and Appendix D sweep configurations are identical.

E4.justification: The real/synthetic-data mixture analysis in Section 4 and linear-regression hyperparameter analyses in Appendix E are unchanged. No ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix D retains the same seed sweeps from 0 through 99. Section 4's statistical estimation and F-test reporting, and the figures' uncertainty displays, are unchanged.

E6.justification: Experimental curves and result entries in Figures 1–20 are identical. Section 4 also retains the same R-squared values of 0.59 and 0.34, p-values, and qualitative findings.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorem 1, and the Gaussian and KDE lemmas, theorems, derivations, and proofs in Appendices B–C are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and Discussion retain the same claims about accumulation preventing collapse, fixed-compute behavior, and the context-dependent value of synthetic data.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the experimental results, the KDE bandwidth qualification, and the discussion of compute constraints and unfiltered synthetic data remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix D's implementation listings, hyperparameters, and existing links are unchanged, as are Section 4's generation, filtering, and dataset-construction details.

R1.justification: v4 adds Gillman et al. (2024), Self-correcting self-consuming loops for generative model training, to the introductory citation list and bibliography. This is a limited citation addition; the positioning narrative and Appendix A remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Textual edits are limited to the added citation and reference entry and the updated arXiv version/date stamp. The prose and section organization otherwise match.

P2.justification: The added citation and reference cause local line and column reflow on pages 1, 11, and 12. All other rendered pages, including Figures 1–20 and their captions, axes, and legends, are identical.

improvement.justification: The added Gillman et al. citation slightly broadens acknowledgment of prior work but receives no accompanying discussion. Scientific evidence, theory, reproducibility information, and substantive exposition remain unchanged, so this bibliographic addition and local reflow do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
